# S54 — Tests inherit enclosing project state when temporary directories are inside the workspace

**Findings:** S52 validation; three failures with workspace-local TMPDIR · **Size: S** · **Tree:** tests

**Not in this slice:** changing slicer root discovery or weakening assertions to accept inherited state.

## Why

Running the suite with TMPDIR inside this checkout causes two outside-project tests to discover the enclosing .slicer directory, and a not-a-Git-repository test to discover its Git repository. S52 validation ran 443 tests with these three failures. Workspace-restricted contributors need an isolated way to run the suite.

## Files

tests/support.py; tests/test_cli.py; tests/test_errors.py; tests/test_isolation.py; AGENTS.md.

## Failing tests

The outside-project and not-a-Git-repository tests should retain their intended meaning when temporary directories live beneath a slicer/Git project.

## Implement

Add support.isolated_discovery(root), a scoped test-only context manager. Hide only ancestor .slicer/config.json existence probes above the fixture root while delegating other checks to the real filesystem. Temporarily set GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES to the fixture root's parent. Restore both patches on exit, including exceptions.

Use the helper explicitly in the two outside-project CLI tests and the not-a-Git-repository test. Preserve their assertions and production discovery semantics. Cover enclosing projects, the fixture's own project and subdirectory discovery, unrelated filesystem checks, and restoration of present or absent environment settings after normal and exceptional exit. Document workspace-local TMPDIR under the ignored .venv/test-tmp directory.

## Check

Run the full suite with temporary directories inside the checkout and confirm isolation, including the three previously failing cases.
